notes: 73 rows in eleven complete city-table headings visually reviewed, resolving to fourteen airport pairs. 21 new nonstop schedules, 51 connections and one through-stop row excluded.
Eleven accepted schedules are Delta mainline; ten are Atlantic Southeast Airlines. The triangle and page 4 number range 1200–1299 identify all ten ASA rows.

Accepted X7 rows: Delta 1114 BHM–MEM and 564 MEM–LGA. Accepted X6 rows: Delta 977 MEM–BHM, 582 MEM–LGA and 597 LGA–MEM. All other accepted rows are daily, including all ASA rows. No accepted row has a dated footnote.

New York heading uses J=Kennedy, L=LaGuardia, E=Newark. Actual airport suffixes are retained separately in the transcription. All accepted New York rows use LGA. MEM–JFK, MEM–EWR and EWR–MEM rows are connections only.
Under legend p4, star means off-peak fare, not next-day arrival. All accepted flights arrive the same local calendar day. Excluded BHM–SHV 19:50 connection arrives 00:24 next day.
BHM, MGM, VPS, JAN, SHV and MEM use UTC−6; ATL and LGA UTC−5. Independent fixed-offset and weekday calculation matches every generated movement.
ASA 1289 ATL–VPS (21:46–23:06 UTC) and ASA 1288 VPS–ATL (21:40–23:00 UTC) overlap the beginning of the window and each contributes three movements. Other new schedules contribute two.
ATL–VPS 1289 is 16:46–17:06 local; the final minute digits were checked in an enlarged scan. ATL–VPS 1286 is 09:48–10:08, 1287 11:47–12:07, 1288 15:16–15:30. Return 1287 is 12:20–14:40.
BHM–SHV 551 is nonstop, but every SHV–BHM row is a connection. No reverse nonstop is invented. JAN–BHM is printed p112, SHV–BHM p224; adjacent Jacksonville/South Bend tables are not substituted.
Previously sourced 500/551/557/725/982 chains are filled by individually printed Birmingham/Jackson/Shreveport legs. Through DFW–BHM or BHM–DFW rows remain excluded, not duplicate flights.
ASA 1286–1289 ATL–VPS–ATL rotations agree with itinerary p264; 1285 starts at VPS. ASA 1290 ATL–MGM–VPS is represented by earlier ATL–MGM plus new MGM–VPS; through ATL–VPS is excluded.
Twenty-one same-operator/flight-number transitions involving new legs have independently verified ground intervals of 10–35 minutes. This does not establish aircraft identity.

Delta 597 LGA–MEM is independently printed and accepted. The conflicting onward MEM–LIT time row from batch80 remains held, with no guessed arrival or interval. Later MEM–LIT evidence is still required.

All prior movements, schedules, airlines and airports unchanged; prior corrections and held conflicts retained. Later amendments and timetable end date unverified.
